title: Full requirement backlog — the brief, line by line
note: Every requirement line from the project brief, including the 28 already registered in data/requirements.json (R01-R28) and the lines added by this session (R29-R87). Each row names the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it.

rows.requirement: Decide the price-data policy before any backtest is published
rows.blocking_gate: Two sessions resolved the same question oppositely (F23/F39): one withholds third-party prices from every published cell, one labels and shows them
rows.clears_when: 1 written policy, recorded in COORDINATION.md, applied to 100% of published tables (0 rows contradicting it)

rows.requirement: Vig-free market consensus vs originated fair-line decomposition view
rows.blocking_gate: Decomposing vig needs a market price with a known margin structure; no official league source prices NFL lines (F18/F23)
rows.clears_when: 1 price feed with both sides quoted, so the overround is computable, for 272 markets x 1 season

rows.requirement: Price a line ourselves and publish the residual against the market, on a schedule, from day one
rows.blocking_gate: No approved market price source; a residual needs two numbers and one is missing (F37/F38)
rows.clears_when: residual published for every originated market within 24h of origination, cadence >= 1/week, 0 missing rows

rows.requirement: Pre-register every strategy; forbid backtest numbers from ever appearing on the leaderboard
rows.blocking_gate: No per-strategy registration anchored to a commit hash; demotion thresholds Q33/SG31 are not frozen
rows.clears_when: 1 commit per strategy holding frozen rule text + sample window + gates, hash published on its row; 0 leaderboard rows carrying a backtest number

rows.requirement: Split data into train, validation and final holdout seasons
rows.blocking_gate: One season only (2026, 137 games); a three-way split needs multiple seasons archived
rows.clears_when: >= 3 seasons archived and split, with the final holdout untouched until a pre-registered date

rows.requirement: Turn the 136-game log into the pre-registered backtest corpus
rows.blocking_gate: Corpus exists (137 results) but is not frozen by a commit, and train/val/holdout membership is not declared
rows.clears_when: 1 commit freezing the corpus + the split + the evaluation window, hash published; reproducibility re-run clean

rows.requirement: Add a two-sided 'what would change our mind' field to every strategy entry
rows.blocking_gate: data/strategies.json has no such field on any row
rows.clears_when: 2 frozen free-text fields (evidence-for / evidence-against) on 6 of 6 strategy rows, written before any result exists
rows.evidence: Two-sided 'what would change our mind' field added to every strategy entry (data/strategies.json change_of_mind upgrade/downgrade), rendered on the Leaderboard (committed by session fc0ed6e8; carried on main).

rows.requirement: Add a control baseline (random picks; favourites only) to every leaderboard run
rows.blocking_gate: No random-pick or favourites-only control row exists in the register
rows.clears_when: 2 control rows in every leaderboard run, scored with the same proper score; a candidate must beat both
rows.evidence: Control baseline (random picks / favourites-only) ranked in the same table as the model strategies on the removal-of-luck panel (data/luck_panel.json; committed by session 38a78804).

rows.requirement: Publish every model total twice until one wins
rows.blocking_gate: Only one totals estimator is specified, and it is unfitted (F33/F38)
rows.clears_when: 2 estimators published side by side with a gap column for >= 1 full season, collapsed only after a pre-registered walk-forward comparison

rows.requirement: Compute and publish the 'removal of luck' panel on the site dashboard
rows.clears_when: — (panel published; see removal-of-luck.html)

rows.requirement: Rank with proper scores and uncertainty, not win rate
rows.blocking_gate: Ranking is signal-only, but not yet benchmark-relative Brier skill with a game-cluster lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment
rows.clears_when: every ranked row publishes benchmark-relative Brier skill, a game-cluster bootstrap lower bound, n, and the multiplicity adjustment; 0 rows ranked on win rate alone

rows.requirement: Use proper-score leaderboard divisions (singles, game parlays, SGPs, prop combos)
rows.blocking_gate: Divisions are described in the design document but no division table is published or populated
rows.clears_when: 4 divisions, each with its own benchmark and eligibility rule, published as separate tables

rows.requirement: Two-stage skill leaderboard: proper-score qualification, then prospective CLV/ROI escrow
rows.blocking_gate: Stage two needs closing-line values, which need a price feed (F37), and a prospective window that has not opened
rows.clears_when: stage 1: proper-score qualification on >= 1 season; stage 2: >= 8 consecutive weeks of prospective, pre-kickoff-recorded marks

rows.requirement: Keep parlays and prop combos behind a joint-evidence gate
rows.blocking_gate: No directly validated joint probability and no operator void/push rules are stored; marginals cannot be multiplied under dependence
rows.clears_when: for each combo family: a joint probability validated on historical data + the operator's void/push rule stored; otherwise the combo is unranked

rows.requirement: Add injury and personnel ablations instead of fixed penalties (test the same model with and without the features, report the difference with uncertainty)
rows.blocking_gate: No ablation harness, and the personnel features themselves are blocked by the unverified depth source (R71)
rows.clears_when: identical model fit twice on >= 3 chronological holdouts, difference reported with a 95% interval

rows.requirement: Reject: ranking strategies by season-long ROI
rows.blocking_gate: Rejected as a ranking key: ROI over one season cannot separate skill from variance at these sample sizes
rows.clears_when: — (recorded so the shortcut is not re-proposed; ranking stays on proper scores, R57)

rows.requirement: 2026 kickoff and declared onside-kick regime priors filter
rows.blocking_gate: No captured source of the 2026 kickoff rule text or of club-declared onside-kick intent
rows.clears_when: official rule text captured and linked; priors applied only where the rule is quoted, never assumed

rows.requirement: Stadium roof/surface and NWS hourly wind/precipitation overlay
rows.blocking_gate: No stadium roof/surface register and no per-fixture forecast capture; the 90-minute roof designation is not captured anywhere
rows.clears_when: 32/32 venues with surface + roof type captured, and an hourly NWS grid forecast captured per fixture at T-24h and T-90min
rows.evidence: Stadium roof/surface overlay built from the Game Book venue line (data/weather_overlay.tsv); NWS forecast grids resolved for 11 of 13 Week 11 venues (data/venue_spotchecks.json). Remaining gap: the NWS hourly wind/precipitation VALUES are not retained in this capture (left blank, not inferred); a refresh re-reads each grid. Estadio Azteca and FedExField have no resolved NWS grid yet.

rows.requirement: Treat the injury report as a timestamped series, not a weekly snapshot
rows.blocking_gate: Only two dated reads exist (2026-11-14 and 2026-11-16); a series needs at least three points per week
rows.clears_when: >= 3 timed captures per week for >= 4 consecutive weeks (Wed, Thu, Fri plus game day) = >= 12 captures

rows.requirement: Snapshot the nfl.com injury report every Wed, Thu and Fri and keep a dated history
rows.blocking_gate: No scheduled job captures the injury report; the only scheduler in the repo refreshes a third-party games feed
rows.clears_when: a scheduled append-only capture on Wed, Thu and Fri, proven over >= 1 full week, with hashes retained

rows.requirement: Store every injury-hub read with its clock time and publish the delta, never the level
rows.blocking_gate: Captures are dated but carry no clock time; with two reads the delta is publishable for one interval only
rows.clears_when: UTC clock time + sha256 on every read; delta published for >= 3 reads per week per player

rows.requirement: Make the injury signal a surprise, never a level
rows.blocking_gate: A surprise needs a prior read to difference against; two reads exist, so one delta is computable (R74)
rows.clears_when: >= 4 consecutive weeks of multi-day reads, then the model consumes only the delta

rows.requirement: Calibrate what 'Questionable' means empirically instead of using old percentages
rows.blocking_gate: Calibration needs designations joined to official inactive lists; no inactive list is captured (R50) and no past-season archive exists (R85)
rows.clears_when: >= 2 seasons x 32 clubs of designation-to-play joins; play rate per designation with a 95% interval
rows.evidence: — (no official percentage is quoted anywhere on this site)

rows.requirement: Score injury-designation reliability before using it as a feature
rows.blocking_gate: Same missing join as R63: designation rows cannot be scored without the actual play/inactive outcome
rows.clears_when: reliability table published per designation with n and interval before the label enters any model

rows.requirement: Archive weekly injury reports for past seasons (for Q06)
rows.blocking_gate: The nfl.com injuries URL exposes season and week selectors, but no archive has been captured and no redistribution terms were read
rows.clears_when: >= 2 past seasons captured week by week, with hashes, after the terms question is answered

rows.requirement: Capture the reserve list so 'not listed' never means 'available'
rows.blocking_gate: No reserve/injured-reserve capture per club; absence from the weekly report is currently ambiguous
rows.clears_when: 32/32 clubs with a dated reserve list captured weekly, so every 'not listed' row carries a reason
rows.evidence: nfl.com news: Patriots place TreVeyon Henderson on IR; Dolphins place Malik Willis on IR (linked on the Snapshot Ledger page)

rows.requirement: Populate the three missing Lions game-status designations (Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays, D.J. Reed)
rows.clears_when: — (re-verified on the official page 2026-11-16: all three are published Out; check G-V5)
rows.evidence: data/injuries.tsv DET rows; data/verification-g.tsv G-V5 PASS

rows.requirement: Re-capture and republish the Week 10 injury tables
rows.blocking_gate: — (re-captured 2026-11-16: 347 rows; published 2026-11-14: 345 rows)
rows.clears_when: — (the review's 254/279 row figures match neither capture; see flag F53)

rows.requirement: Point-in-Time Snapshot Ledger for injuries, depth charts and inactives
rows.blocking_gate: Injuries ledger started (2 dated reads with hashes); depth and inactives are not yet in the ledger
rows.clears_when: one ledger covering 3 evidence types x 32 clubs x >= 3 reads/week, each row carrying hash, timestamp and conflict flag

rows.requirement: Automate immutable multi-day availability snapshots
rows.blocking_gate: Captures are manual; the only scheduled workflow does not touch the injury report or depth charts
rows.clears_when: scheduled append-only capture on Wed, Thu, Fri and game day, proven over >= 1 week with hashes retained

rows.requirement: Build immutable official availability snapshots (injury reports, club depth pages, inactive evidence: raw hashes, timestamps, conflict flags)
rows.blocking_gate: Injury and depth captures exist; inactives are not captured (R50) and conflict flags are prose notes rather than row fields
rows.clears_when: store covering 3 evidence types, every row with sha256 + UTC timestamp + conflict flag

rows.requirement: Capture official inactive lists and snap counts
rows.blocking_gate: No machine-readable official inactives or snap-count source has been identified; only a prose news article (Week 9 inactives) was seen
rows.clears_when: 32/32 clubs' inactives available pre-kickoff, and snap counts for 100% of players in >= 1 season
rows.evidence: Official inactive lists and the Game Book Playtime Percentage table captured for all 13 games (data/gamebooks_rosters.tsv role inactive/dnp; data/gamebooks_snaps.tsv). Caveat: the Playtime Percentage is the Game Book's playtime measure, and 4 of 13 books label it '(Unofficial)' (flag F67); it is not an official snap-count table.

rows.requirement: Build the availability graph as a first-class dataset (who was expected to start, who actually did)
rows.blocking_gate: Actual starters are not captured anywhere; the only official evidence found is prose news, and no snap counts exist (F09)
rows.clears_when: official Game Book or snap-count capture for 1 season: 32 clubs x 17 weeks = 544 team-games, expected-vs-actual join rate >= 0.98
rows.evidence: data/availability_2025.csv (derived from a third-party mirror, flagged)

rows.requirement: Use official NFL Game Books for actual starters and game-day status; do not infer depth rank or snaps
rows.blocking_gate: No Game Book capture pipeline exists
rows.clears_when: 1 Game Book fetched per completed game, starters and inactives parsed, 32/32 clubs covered
rows.evidence: Official NFL Game Books for all 13 completed Week 10 games captured (data/gamebooks_{games,rosters,snaps}.tsv): actual starters, substitutions, DNP, inactives, game-day weather/roof/surface and playtime, transcribed from the official PDFs (S90). Verified by tools/verify_gamebooks.py (GB-1..GB-8).

rows.requirement: Do not model depth from jersey order; model it from playing time
rows.blocking_gate: No official snap counts (F09); the club charts in use are self-described 'unofficial' (F10)
rows.clears_when: official snap-share source covering 32/32 clubs, with the starter threshold pre-registered before use

rows.requirement: Use snap counts as the starter proxy when the depth chart is unavailable
rows.blocking_gate: Same missing source as R31
rows.clears_when: snap-share proxy evaluated against the club chart on >= 1 season; agreement rate published
rows.evidence: Game Book Playtime Percentage captured as the starter/playing-time proxy for 13 games (data/gamebooks_snaps.tsv). Remaining gap: 4 of 13 books label the table '(Unofficial)' (F67), so it is a strong proxy but not a certified official snap count on those games.

rows.requirement: Reject: deriving depth order from jersey number, experience or salary
rows.blocking_gate: Rejected: an inferred order is not evidence, and two clubs in this dataset already break it (shared slots, empty slots)
rows.clears_when: — (recorded so the shortcut is not re-proposed; see R52 and R70)
rows.evidence: data/depth.tsv (149 slots list more than one rank-1 player)

rows.requirement: Resolve the depth-order source before building the backup-deficiency feature
rows.blocking_gate: Route (a) club pages: 31 of 32 captured, Houston publishes an image (F16); route (b) snap counts: no official source (F09)
rows.clears_when: one route verified for all 32 clubs (32/32 parse with >= 0.98 slot coverage) before the feature is built

rows.requirement: Fix the two depth-parsing failures before widening coverage (Houston image; Green Bay jersey numbers)
rows.blocking_gate: Green Bay rows parse (numbers stripped) but the raw string is not stored; Houston publishes its chart as an image and yields 0 rows
rows.clears_when: 32/32 clubs parse; Houston replaced by an authorised structured source, not transcription by eye

rows.requirement: Model depth slots as groups, not a single starter
rows.blocking_gate: data/depth.tsv is a ranked list; 149 club/unit/position slots list more than one rank-1 player
rows.clears_when: schema change to (club, unit, slot, rank, players[]) with a shared-rank flag

rows.requirement: Represent shared and empty depth slots faithfully
rows.blocking_gate: Same schema limitation as R52: shared and empty slots are currently indistinguishable from a ranked list
rows.clears_when: shared-slot and empty-slot flags in the schema, verified against the two known cases (Seattle, Washington)

rows.requirement: Add an official depth-chart register with date and source per row
rows.blocking_gate: data/depth-sources.tsv carries club, source id and URL for 31 clubs, but the capture-date column is empty on 31 of 31 rows
rows.clears_when: capture date on 32/32 rows

rows.requirement: Treat roster turnover as a first-class data event
rows.blocking_gate: No transactions log is captured; depth and availability rows are not versioned against roster events
rows.clears_when: dated roster-event table; every depth/availability row versioned against the last official event
rows.evidence: nfl.com news roundup, Tuesday Nov 10 (Bills acquire Hooker; Broncos trade for Henley)

rows.requirement: Flag stale depth rows against the official transactions log
rows.blocking_gate: Depends on R53 (transactions capture); the Baltimore case is already visible in the news but not machine-readable
rows.clears_when: dated transactions feed + a staleness rule evaluated weekly on 32/32 clubs
rows.evidence: nfl.com news: Ravens officially place Lamar Jackson on injured reserve (2026-11-05)

rows.requirement: Run the 32-team roster/IR sweep before any team-level model is trusted
rows.blocking_gate: Only one club roster page is captured as a worked example; no IR sweep exists
rows.clears_when: 32/32 clubs with a dated roster + reserve capture, re-run on every roster transaction

rows.requirement: Interactive Offense vs Defense matchup deficiency matrix (1st-4th string)
rows.blocking_gate: Depends on R52 (group slots) and R71 (depth source verified for 32/32 clubs)
rows.clears_when: depth source verified 32/32 + group-slot schema shipped, then one matrix per game
rows.evidence: replacement-depth.html (string numbers, club-chart order, labelled unofficial)

rows.requirement: Add an announced-starter evidence field (not an inferred replacement)
rows.clears_when: — (field published; every row links the official article that names the starter)

rows.requirement: Add a per-team view: starters out, replacements named, net injury count
rows.clears_when: — (view published for all 28 clubs on the Week 10 report)

rows.requirement: Store every model output as a probability plus its inputs, not just a pick
rows.blocking_gate: The fair-line model is unfitted (F38), so the stored outputs are lines, not probability + input-vector records
rows.clears_when: every origination row stores p, the input vector, the model id and the coefficient version

rows.requirement: Ingest game-level results to make the ratings opponent-aware
rows.blocking_gate: 137 results are ingested and reconciled 32/32, but no opponent-adjusted rating is published
rows.clears_when: a published rating with its adjustment formula and n, re-fit on the frozen split (R87)

rows.requirement: Start with a singles-only shadow baseline (pre-registered, frozen versions, forecasts recorded before kickoff)
rows.blocking_gate: A baseline exists for 13 Week 10 games, but no frozen-version pre-kickoff record has been produced for a full week
rows.clears_when: >= 1 full week of pre-kickoff forecasts, each with model version + UTC timestamp, published before kickoff

rows.requirement: Add a fixture-context feature set built only from published schedule facts
rows.blocking_gate: Schedule facts are captured, but no fixture-context feature set is defined or published, and venue is filled on 1 of 272 rows
rows.clears_when: a published feature list where every feature traces to a schedule field (rest days, bye, travel, kickoff time, divisional)

rows.requirement: Transcribe the venue of every fixture from the official game centre and publish it
rows.blocking_gate: Venue column exists but is populated for the international game only
rows.clears_when: 272/272 fixtures with venue string + official game-centre URL

rows.requirement: Publish the league's dated schedule announcement beside the live schedule page
rows.blocking_gate: No dated announcement document has been captured or linked
rows.clears_when: the official announcement URL + publication date captured and shown beside schedule.html

rows.requirement: Put a decision-readiness table on the landing page: one row per requirement, with the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it
rows.clears_when: — (table published; 87 rows, one per requirement, this page)

rows.requirement: Publish a weekly 'what changed' diff instead of a static snapshot
rows.blocking_gate: One diff interval exists (2026-11-14 to 2026-11-16, 35 change records); a weekly cadence needs a scheduler (R73)
rows.clears_when: a published diff for every week of the season, each with the capture hashes on both sides

rows.requirement: Add durable snapshot storage and alerts (store captures outside the static site, monitor freshness, alert on source/schema change)
rows.blocking_gate: Snapshots live in the public repository; there is no freshness monitor and no schema alarm
rows.clears_when: off-site append-only store, a freshness SLO of < 6h after publication, and an alert that fires on any schema change

rows.requirement: Add a drift alarm to every scraper
rows.blocking_gate: Row-count and per-row-source gates run at build time (tools/checkrows.py, tools/checklinks.py) but they are not monitors and do not page anyone
rows.clears_when: every parser pinned to an expected row count and required field list, failing loudly in CI and alerting on drift

rows.requirement: Split the site into a public analysis layer and a private data layer
rows.blocking_gate: Row-level official data is currently published in the public site, and the redistribution terms have not been read
rows.clears_when: terms read and recorded, then raw row-level data moved to a private store with the public site keeping derived analysis + links only
